question: Please identify the top three customers, based on their customer_unique_id, who have the highest number of delivered orders, and provide the average payment value, city, and state for each of these customers.
sql:
-- Final query: top 3 customers by delivered orders
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id
    FROM olist_orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_delivered_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(d.order_id) as delivered_order_count
    FROM olist_customers c
    JOIN delivered_orders d ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
customer_avg_payment AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        AVG(p.payment_value) as avg_payment_value
    FROM olist_customers c
    JOIN delivered_orders d ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
    JOIN olist_order_payments p ON d.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
customer_location AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        customer_city,
        customer_state,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_unique_id ORDER BY customer_city) as rn
    FROM olist_customers
)
SELECT 
    cdc.customer_unique_id,
    cdc.delivered_order_count,
    ROUND(cap.avg_payment_value, 2) as avg_payment_value,
    cl.customer_city,
    cl.customer_state
FROM customer_delivered_counts cdc
JOIN customer_avg_payment cap ON cdc.customer_unique_id = cap.customer_unique_id
JOIN customer_location cl ON cdc.customer_unique_id = cl.customer_unique_id AND cl.rn = 1
ORDER BY cdc.delivered_order_count DESC
LIMIT 3
